subject: Acme Corp — evaluation kickoff & trial plan
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — evaluation kickoff & trial plan

Connor — thanks again for the call today. Helpful to walk through Redwood's serving/runtime approach and the Dedicated vs hosted options. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an evaluation started: 

- Goal: Validate latency and cost for our summarization pipeline (internal docs -> short brief). Success criteria: median tail latency < 1.2s for 512-token runs and cost per 1k tokens below our current baseline.
- Scope: 2-week eval with up to 3 engineers testing model integration and prompts; we'd like transcript-level logging + token breakdown for the tests.
- Request: schedule an evaluation kickoff (trial plan, prompt set, access details, and technical deep dive) next week. Prefer Tue/Wed windows in the morning PST.

I attached a rough internal checklist we use; also looping in Priya (engineering lead) to help pick a slot. Let us know what works and any access pre-reqs.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Product Manager, Acme Corp
Sam.Patel@acme.com

Attachment: redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf (stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — evaluation kickoff & trial plan

Sam — really appreciate the clear goals and the success criteria. Happy to kick off the eval. Quick responses to your bullets and next steps: 

- Goal & metrics: noted. We'll instrument token-level cost and median/tail latency for the 512-token slices during the eval and share a dashboard. Marissa will own the evaluation plan and the reporting.
- Scope & access: We'll provision a short-lived API key scoped to the eval project and a sandbox dataset; we'll also configure KV/prefix caching suggestions once we see prompt patterns.
- Timing: Proposed kickoff slots (PST): Tue 2026-03-10 9:30–10:00, Tue 2026-03-10 11:00–11:30, Wed 2026-03-11 9:00–9:30. Please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite.

I've attached a one-page trial plan we use for evaluations and included a Calendly link if you want self-serve scheduling. Marissa — can you lead the kickoff and cover the trial timeline + prompt/eval set generation? Neha — can you prepare a short tech checklist (network IP allowlist, expected data sample, and sandbox provisioning steps)?

Link to meeting: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?invite=acme
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-0042

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193
